mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_marker_history (screen_history_id, marker_id, marker_no, author_account_id, author_name, selector, element_label, relative_x, relative_y, document_x, document_y, description, created_at, updated_at) select #{historyId}, id, marker_no, author_account_id, author_name, selector, element_label, relative_x, relative_y, document_x, document_y, description, created_at, updated_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_marker where frd_screen_id = #{frdScreenId} order by marker_no
mapper.select: select mh.marker_id, h.frd_screen_id, mh.marker_no, mh.author_account_id, mh.author_name, mh.selector, mh.element_label, mh.relative_x, mh.relative_y, mh.document_x, mh.document_y, mh.description, mh.created_at, mh.updated_at from builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_marker_history mh join builder.adk_builder_frd_screen_history h on h.id = mh.screen_history_id where mh.screen_history_id = #{historyId} order by mh.marker_no
